serialized_basis.before_sha256_and_after_sha256: SHA256(json.dumps(parsed_document, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")); Python defaults ensure_ascii=True, separators=(", ", ": "), no trailing newline. These are normalized Python serialization hashes, NOT raw file hashes and NOT Decision closure hashes.
serialized_basis.original_shape_compact_bytes: len(json.dumps(RegisteredExtensions_shape,separators=(",", ":"))) with Python default ensure_ascii=True; original shape includes Chinese description encoded as ASCII escapes. 285 counts serialized ASCII characters/bytes.
serialized_basis.decision_schema_raw_before_and_after: len(contract.Schema("DecisionEnvelope")) Go json.Marshal after transitive $defs closure and recursive removal of title/description; these values do not measure whole Schema file.
serialized_basis.measured_wire_savings_identical_content: Difference of Provider.Encode byte lengths on identical recorded Context and short prompt, old inline closure versus shared closure, double JSON encoding included; 31794 - 31290 = 504 bytes. Values omit grant capabilities in both paired measurements; final-with-grant was measured separately.

actual_file_sha256.before_verification: Recorded original file hash; reconstructed saved pre-refactor parsed document with original indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, newline reproduces this hash.

closure_length_reproduction.method: Python mirror of contract.Schema transitive closure, removal of description/title, sorted compact UTF-8 JSON with Go HTML/U+2028/U+2029 escaping
